visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair stands in the center of an expansive outdoor concrete plaza under a gray, overcast sky. She is wearing a dark gray sports bra, light gray athletic shorts with a white waistband, white crew socks, and white sneakers. Behind her is a large industrial-style building with a tall, prominent smokestack and several green trees. (2) The camera performs a rapid digital zoom, framing the woman in a medium shot as she begins to jump rope. She holds black handles and swings the rope rhythmically, her face showing a focused, neutral expression while her hair bounces with each jump. (3) The framing remains close as she continues the exercise. The background reveals a patch of green grass and the gray walls of the adjacent building. The woman maintains a steady jumping pace until the video ends.

These percussive transients are clear and centered in the mix, perfectly synchronized with the musical beat. The whistling BGM and the rhythmic rope impacts continue with consistent intensity until the audio track ends.
